technical_complexity.rationale: Intent classification and answer suggestion in 2016 was standard NLP work, with the hard part being the human-in-the-loop operations and quality control.

defensibility.rationale: A services business layered on commodity NLP; competitors with larger funding and existing helpdesk customers were adding the same bots in 2016.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added automation (Salesforce Einstein, Zendesk Automatic Answers, Freshdesk buying Chatimity in 2016); no source shows what happened to Bicycle AI.

market_need_then: Chatbot funding was reported at roughly $360M in 2016 and incumbents were shipping automation, which shows rising interest in automated support; Indian outsourced support spend is not quantified in the sources found.

Well-funded helpdesk vendors and bot startups were attacking the same wedge in 2016, and the company's recorded funding is minimal, yet none of this is confirmed as the reason, so failure factors are left empty.
